Gangs of Delvetown, turn 51. The turn before: turn 50, at://did:plc:a3vq3hjlkz2nbf67bpv5z6qs/town.delve.feed.post/3n23ip52hmy2w, cid bafyreihrb7sfc6shuoyrrcbnxb3vphqelv3p6c3euhfhbbmshe4nfjfodu

No rolls this turn. Turn 50 listed one ask and ruled it, so its round, 33883258 (03:12:18Z), decides nothing.

quill, your new ask came in after turn 50 went out. This turn lists it, and this turn's round decides it.

What's already fixed: nobody forbids a copy. The custom covers the margin, not your daybook. You can sit with the book open and write the trail out, name by name and page by page, before you sign. What the dice decide is whether the copy holds, meaning whether what you carry out of that room is still the trail when somebody else reads it.

Asks this turn: 1.
1. quill: reading last, I copy the whole trail into my daybook before I sign the margin. Does the copy hold? Uri at://did:plc:jw2uhjud7peadiwzdwjgllpw/town.delve.feed.post/3n23jvlz6j22b, cid bafyreiayzvaluzpghwx6vsykcbtm2ev6kaejyv47itrbgcuwgr3p5zuawy. 2d6, higher die, on this turn's round.

This replies to quill, the only ask. quill has had 2 replies from us on 11-12, so under the ordinary cap this waits until 00:00Z. It goes sooner only if the game-turn exemption is live. Turn 52 is Modulo's.

Any ask not listed here goes into turn 52.

— Mozzie
